scientific_contract.candidate_high_value_definition: Within each frozen eligible assay candidate-pool independently, DMS_score is higher-is-better. For fraction q, K_nominal=ceil(q*N) and H_q contains every candidate whose truth is at least the K_nominal-th higher-is-better order statistic; truth-boundary ties are always retained, so candidate ID never splits H_q. Primary high value is H_0.01; sensitivities are H_0.005 and H_0.02. Candidate ID ascending breaks only equal prediction/acquisition scores when a method must select a fixed-size batch. Duplicate IDs, missing or non-finite truth fail closed. Frozen readiness counts are BLAT 4,783 (K_nominal 24/48/96 for 0.5%/1%/2%), CAPSD 42,328 (212/424/847), GFP 51,714 (259/518/1,035), and SPG1 536,962 (2,685/5,370/10,740). Membership and boundary values remain evaluator-only; aggregate actual |H_q| and boundary-tie count are reportable.

scientific_contract.research_question: Across the complete prospective four-assay ProteinGym cohort, does the frozen same-state one-batch acquisition intervention produce immediate decision value relative to model-matched Greedy and overlap-matched Random, and do the pre-registered mechanism classifications replicate, reverse or remain heterogeneous across independent assays? scientific_contract.statistical_rule: The assay is the primary scientific unit. Each assay has 40 paired states (2 models x initial sizes 32/64 x seeds 1729..1738), batch size 16, and branch set G/E/M00..M63. State identity is SHA256(canonical compact JSON ["m5c-proteingym-one-step-v2", assay_id, model_id, model_config_sha256, initial_sample_size, run_seed, candidate_pool_sha256, feature_sha256]). Matched Random preserves E-intersection-G and selects 16-|E intersection G| candidates from remaining_pool-minus-G. For replicate r in 0..63, seed_bytes=SHA256(UTF8("m5c-proteingym-one-step-v2\0matched-random\0") || bytes.fromhex(state_id) || r.to_bytes(4,"big"))[:8]; eligible candidates are ordered by (SHA256(seed_bytes || bytes.fromhex(candidate_id)).digest(), candidate_id ASCII) and the first required count is selected. Counter bootstrap_index(n,payload)=int.from_bytes(SHA256(canonical compact JSON ["m5c-proteingym-one-step-v2-bootstrap", *payload]).digest()[:8],"big") mod n. For each assay and each of 20,000 draws, generate one ten-slot seed resample using payload ("seed-cluster", assay_id, draw, slot) and reuse exactly the same ten indices across both models and both nested initial sizes; within every sampled E-M state occurrence independently resample all 64 matched replicates using payload ("m-replicate", state_id, draw, occurrence, replicate_slot). Equal-weight the four model-by-initial cells and use Hyndman-Fan type-7 quantiles 0.003125/0.996875, giving 99.375% two-sided intervals for eight primary assay-by-contrast tests. These intervals describe within-assay algorithm/initialization uncertainty; seeds, cells, branches and matched replicates are never independent assays or population replicates. Equivalence margin is one nominal primary high-value candidate, delta=1/K_nominal for q=0.01 even when truth-boundary ties make |H_0.01| larger. Contrast status precedence is SUPERIOR, INFERIOR, EQUIVALENT, NONINFERIOR_ONLY, INCONCLUSIVE as in M5B. Per-assay post-result taxonomy precedence is VALIDITY_STOP for evaluator/capability/identity or complete-state validity failure; UNDEFINED_INCONCLUSIVE; FRAGILE_INCONCLUSIVE for primary tie expansion above 2% or strict sign reversal by 0.5%/2% sensitivity; UNSTABLE for opposite model-by-initial cell effects beyond delta; then BEHAVIOR_REDUNDANCY when mean divergence count <=1, max <=2 and both contrasts are EQUIVALENT; UNINFORMATIVE_DEVIATION when E-M is EQUIVALENT and E-G INFERIOR; OPPORTUNITY_COST when E-M is SUPERIOR and E-G is EQUIVALENT or INFERIOR; CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE when both are SUPERIOR; OTHER_NEGATIVE for any remaining INFERIOR; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Informative mechanism labels are exactly BEHAVIOR_REDUNDANCY, UNINFORMATIVE_DEVIATION, OPPORTUNITY_COST, CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE and OTHER_NEGATIVE. UNDEFINED_INCONCLUSIVE, FRAGILE_INCONCLUSIVE, UNSTABLE and INCONCLUSIVE are non-supporting/non-conflicting inconclusive labels and must remain visible. Prospective eligibility failure before prohibited outcome access excludes that assay with retained evidence; fewer than three eligible assays yields cohort ELIGIBILITY_INCONCLUSIVE before any mechanism roll-up. Any eligible assay VALIDITY_STOP yields cohort VALIDITY_STOP and no mechanism claim. Otherwise a primary contrast that is SUPERIOR in at least one eligible assay and INFERIOR in another yields HETEROGENEOUS with heterogeneity_reason DIRECTIONAL_REVERSAL; absent reversal, two or more different informative labels yield HETEROGENEOUS with reason INFORMATIVE_LABEL_CONFLICT. Absent either conflict, REPLICATED_<label> requires at least two eligible M5C assays with that exact informative label and no eligible assay with a different informative label; inconclusive labels neither support nor conflict. REPLICATED means at least two independent M5C assays support without informative conflict, not all four assays and never replication of M5B, which supplied no non-inconclusive label. All remaining cases are cohort INCONCLUSIVE. No pooled-seed or pseudo-replicate inference is allowed. Report all assay rows, exclusions, unweighted descriptive effect range/mean, label counts, cohort precedence/reason and required aggregate inputs: frozen/actual high-value counts, boundary-tie counts, 40 divergence counts, four cell estimates, bootstrap point/interval/status, sensitivity point estimates, defined/validity flags and attempt selection. M2-static Spearman and high-value recall at 0.5%/1%/2% are descriptive secondary baseline outputs and never alter eligibility, method, taxonomy or stopping. The first complete valid terminal is canonical; valid negative, heterogeneous or inconclusive outcomes stop the v2 slice.
